en.title: Spain's Plus Ultra files for creditor protection, keeps only Venezuela routes
en.summary: Spanish long-haul carrier Plus Ultra filed for preliminary creditor protection on November 13, giving it three months to agree a restructuring plan with creditors; it will halt all scheduled services except Caracas–Madrid and Caracas–Tenerife North, shift toward ACMI leasing, and cut most of its roughly 670 staff.
body: Spanish long-haul carrier Plus Ultra Líneas Aéreas is preparing a thorough restructuring after filing for preliminary creditor protection on November 13, 2026. The airline will have three months, extendable by another three, to agree a restructuring plan with its creditors. According to several Spanish media outlets, it will stop all scheduled operations except services linking Caracas with Madrid-Barajas and Tenerife-North, and will orient most of its activity towards the ACMI market, leasing its aircraft to other operators. Workforce cuts are expected to affect most of its approximately 670 members of staff.

As of November 2026, Plus Ultra operates seven Airbus A330 widebody aircraft — five -200s and two -300s — from its hub in Madrid. Until now, its network focused mostly on Latin American destinations, such as Lima, Buenos Aires and Caracas; service to Cartagena de Indias had already been suspended in June 2026. The airline blamed the hike in fuel prices resulting from the military conflict in the Middle East for its financial difficulties, and linked keeping only its Venezuela service to being able to source cheaper fuel there. It repeatedly suspended operations to Venezuela over the last twelve months, and the massive earthquake in La Guaira in June 2026 also disrupted operations into the country.

The airline is also embroiled in a criminal investigation in Spain over the €53 million support package granted by the government during the COVID-19 pandemic. Two senior executives were briefly arrested in December 2025 in connection with the allegations and resigned shortly after; the investigation is still ongoing as of November 2026. Plus Ultra is the third Spanish carrier seeking some form of court protection since late September 2026 as a result of the fuel crisis: Volotea filed for preliminary creditor protection in September 2026 and plans to downsize, while charter airline AlbaStar suspended all operations in November 2026 and is preparing to file for insolvency.

zh.title: 西班牙Plus Ultra航空申請債權人保護、僅保留委內瑞拉航線
zh.summary: 西班牙長程航空公司Plus Ultra已於11月13日申請初步債權人保護，將有3個月時間與債權人達成重整計畫；除加拉加斯往返馬德里與北特內里費的定期航班外，其餘定期航線全數停飛，業務重心轉向湿租市場，約70名員工大多將受裁員影響。
body: 西班牙長程航空公司Plus Ultra Líneas Aéreas已於2026年11月13日申請初步債權人保護，展開全面重整。依程序，公司將有3個月時間與債權人達成重整計畫，必要時可再延長3個月。據多家西班牙媒體報導，除目前往返加拉加斯與馬德里巴拉哈斯機場、北特內里費的定期航班外，公司將停飛其餘所有定期航線，並把多數業務轉向湿租市場，將飛機租給其他業者營運。公司約70名員工大多將受裁員影響。

截至2026年11月，Plus Ultra以馬德里為樞紐營運7架空中巴士A330廣體客機，包括5架A330-200與2架A330-300，航網以拉丁美洲為主，包括利馬、布宜諾斯艾利斯與加拉加斯；飛往哥倫比亞卡塔赫納的服務已於2026年6月停飛。公司把財務困境歸因於中東軍事衝突推升燃油價格，並稱保留委內瑞拉航線的原因之一，是能在當地取得較便宜的燃油。過去一幋，公司已多次暫停飛往主要市場委內瑞拉的航班，2026年6月拉瓜伊拉大地震也干擾了當地營運。
公司還面臨西班牙的刑事調查，涉及疫情期間政府提供的5300萬歐元紓紙金。兩名高層已於2025年12月因相關指控短暫被捕後辭職，調查截至2026年11月仍在進行中。Plus Ultra是自2026年9月底以來第三家因燃油危機尋求法院保護的西班牙航空公司；Volotea已於9月申請初步債權人保護並計畫縮減規模，包機航空公司AlbaStar則於11月停飛全部營運、準備聲請破產。
